veranderings.voor: Klein blare beteken minder waterverlies as groot blare.
veranderings.na: Met klein blare is daar minder waterverlies as met groot blare.
veranderings.rede: The original compares water loss with leaves; this compares like with like and keeps 'waterverlies'.
Light is 'opgevang' in Afrikaans, as the same block says a sentence later; 'vang sonlig' alone is unidiomatic.

veranderings.voor: groei, nie deur mense geplant nie.
veranderings.na: groei en nie deur mense geplant is nie.
veranderings.rede: The loose participle phrase has no verb; joining it to the relative clause makes the definition grammatical.
